Provides a resource to create a TEO security JavaScript injection rule.

## Example Usage

</div>

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="javascript,typescript">

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.teo.SecurityJsInjectionRule("example", {
    zoneId: "zone-3fkff38fyw8s",
    jsInjectionRules: {
        name: "tf-example",
        priority: 50,
        condition: "${http.request.host} in ['www.demo.com']",
        injectJs: "inject-sdk-only",
    },
});
```

## Import



TEO security JavaScript injection rule can be imported using the zoneId#ruleId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/securityJsInjectionRule:SecurityJsInjectionRule example zone-3fkff38fyw8s#inject-0000040467
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
